summary: Selen, the land of rangers: Harion's country, the frontier watch, the Stranger on the shore and the Host of the Heir.

ranger_lodges.name: Ranger Lodges
ranger_lodges.desc: Hearths and bow-racks in the greenwood school the finest woodsmen in the Concord.

ranger_lodges_2.name: Lodges on Every Road
ranger_lodges_2.desc: A lodge at every crossroads: rangers are never far from shelter, a map or a friend.

greenwood_ways.name: The Greenwood Ways
greenwood_ways.desc: Every trail has a name and every child knows it; strangers lose their way, and the wardens lose none of theirs.

warden_host_spirit.name: The Warden Host
warden_host_spirit.desc: The rangers of every lodge muster beneath the Warden's banner.

the_restorers_land.name: The Restorer's Land
the_restorers_land.desc: Harion's country remembers its king, and does not forget itself.

restorers_land_2.name: Harion's Heirs
restorers_land_2.desc: The line of Harion is honoured in every hall, and the wardens stand a little straighter.

wardens_moot.name: The Wardens' Moot
wardens_moot.desc: The wardens settle what the Warden may not decide alone.

university_of_selen_spirit.name: The University of Selen
university_of_selen_spirit.desc: A university where a hard question may be asked, and sometimes answered.

first_among_dominions.name: First Among the Dominions
first_among_dominions.desc: Selen speaks for dominions that will not speak for themselves.

selen_granaries.name: The Granaries of Selen
selen_granaries.desc: Great granaries and full barns keep the valleys fed and quiet.

lake_trade.name: Trade with the Great Lake
lake_trade.desc: Barge-loads of grain and cloth cross the Great Lake, and goodwill returns with the empties.

frontier_hub.name: The Frontier Hub
frontier_hub.desc: Selen is the meeting-place of the frontier companies, and its captains know it.

shelter_of_the_stranger.name: The Stranger Sheltered
shelter_of_the_stranger.desc: A guest in the greenwood is a secret all the glades keep together.

selen_under_arms_spirit.name: Selen Under Arms
selen_under_arms_spirit.desc: Every lodge is a muster-point and every ranger carries a bow.

free_banners.name: Free Banners of Selen
free_banners.desc: Green banners on a white field, and rangers who need no order to hold them.

peace_of_the_wardens.name: The Wardens' Peace
peace_of_the_wardens.desc: A free realm under a treaty, and builders at work on every lodge.

ranger_watch.name: The Rangers Keep Watch
ranger_watch.desc: Patrols watch the southern road day and night.

ranger_reports.title: The Rangers' Reports
ranger_reports.desc: A band of landless men has camped on the coast road, and the rangers do not know whether they are brigands or only hungry. The wardens must decide what Selen does with those who have nothing.

the_kings_taxes.title: The King's Taxes
the_kings_taxes.desc: Parim's tax-farmers have come with a new levy and the same smile. The Warden may pay it without a word, or he may take the matter to the Moot and have it recorded with the others.

southern_rumours.title: Rumours from the South
southern_rumours.desc: Rangers on the southern road report dust on the horizon, and the dust has been there every morning for a week. Beyond Herez the roads are being used by someone who does not wish to be seen.

alleria_reports.title: Alleria's Report
alleria_reports.desc: Alleria has walked with the Stranger for a month, and she believes that he is [zin_loc_eindil], son of Ein. She asks the Moot whether the wardens should stand with him openly, or whether it is better that the rangers alone know.

focuses.name: The Rangers of Selen
focuses.desc: Selen is the land of rangers. Every hill farm sends a son or a daughter to the greenwood, and the lodges that school them are older than the Charters of Parim.

focuses.name: The Long Patrol
focuses.desc: Rangers walk the whole border in a single season, from the coast to the hills, and sleep in no bed twice. They return with maps, and with knowledge nobody in Parim has asked for.

focuses.name: Alleria's Company
focuses.desc: Alleria of Selen, ranger and archer, gathers a company of the finest woodsmen of the coast. They answer to no lord but the Warden of Selen, and ask very little of him.

focuses.name: Woodcraft and Bow
focuses.desc: Selen's bowyers and its woodsmen share what they know. A bow drawn by a ranger who understands the grain of the stave outshoots any other.

focuses.name: Lodges on Every Road
focuses.desc: A lodge is raised at every crossroads, with a hearth, a rack of bows and a map on the wall. A ranger who reaches one is never more than a day from help.

focuses.name: Hunters of the Coast
focuses.desc: The coast road is watched by hunters who know the tides and the smugglers' coves. They have found strange campfires and stranger company.

focuses.name: The Greenwood Ways
focuses.desc: Selen's rangers have a hundred names for the trails of the greenwood, and they have taught them all to their children. No stranger finds the right path by accident.

focuses.name: The Warden Host
focuses.desc: When the Warden of Selen sounds the horn, the rangers of every lodge assemble beneath his banner. It is a small host, and a very hard one to catch.

focuses.name: Harion's Country
focuses.desc: Harion the Restorer was Selen's son before he was Aenor's king. Every Thaw the wardens keep the Restorer's Day, and every child of Selen is told whose country this is.

focuses.name: The Wardens' Moot
focuses.desc: The wardens meet each season at the old stone circle, to settle what the Warden may and may not decide alone. The list of what he may not is the longer one.

focuses.name: The University of Selen
focuses.desc: Founded beside Parim's in 4A 340, the University of Selen keeps old genealogies, older maps and a few scholars who still read them. It is the only place in the Concord where one may ask a hard question.

focuses.name: Petition for the Old Liberties
focuses.desc: Selen asks Parim, in the Charters' own words, for the liberties its people held in the days of Harion. The Golden Court will read it and be polite.

focuses.name: The King's Taxes
focuses.desc: Parim's tax-farmers arrive each autumn with a new levy and the same smile. Selen pays, as it always has, and counts the cost twice.

focuses.name: Scholars of the First Men
focuses.desc: The university's scholars study the genealogies of the First Men and the lines of their kings. They are few, and what they find, they keep in cases and lock.

focuses.name: A Voice for the Dominions
focuses.desc: Selen offers to speak for the dominions at the Concord Council when they do not wish to speak for themselves. Few will say yes, and many will remember who asked.

focuses.name: Harion's Heirs
focuses.desc: The wardens claim no crown, but they honour the line of Harion in every hall of Selen. A land that remembers its king is a land that does not forget itself.

focuses.name: Fields and Forges
focuses.desc: Selen's river valleys are green and its smiths are patient. A new workshop is raised at the capital, beside the mill-race, in sight of the fields it serves.

focuses.name: The Granaries of Selen
focuses.desc: Great granaries are built at the river crossings and filled each autumn. A winter in Selen is never a hungry one.

focuses.name: River Mills
focuses.desc: Mill-wheels turn on every stream, grinding grain, sawing timber and fulling cloth. The valley roads are widened to carry what they make.

focuses.name: The Ploughmen's Roads
focuses.desc: The farmers of Selen pave their own lanes, stone by stone, and in a season the whole valley is linked by roads a cart can use in any weather.

focuses.name: The Smithies of Selen
focuses.desc: Smiths set up beside the mill-races, where the water drives the hammers. Selen's iron is not the finest, but there is a great deal of it.

focuses.name: Trade with the Great Lake
focuses.desc: Barges carry Selen's grain and cloth across the Great Lake to Parim and bring back coin, lamp-tallow and news. The wardens like the coin and the news equally.

focuses.name: The Armouries of Selen
focuses.desc: Great armouries rise in the river towns, stocked with mail, spears and long ranger-bows. They are meant to be quiet places, and they are not.

focuses.name: The Frontier Watch
focuses.desc: Selen sends its best rangers to the Lost Cause's frontier companies, the one part of the league that is real. They watch the road south and report what they see.

focuses.name: Companies for the League
focuses.desc: Selen raises companies for the Golden King's league against the dark. They march south in good order and write home that the frontier is as quiet as the grave.

focuses.name: Eyes on the South
focuses.desc: Rangers go quietly beyond the frontier posts and come back with dust on their boots and odd tales. The tales are too regular to be dismissed.

focuses.name: Count the Almoners
focuses.desc: A ranger-captain quietly counts the Houses of the First Light in Selen: how many, where, and how well they are supplied. The Deliverer's almoners are generous, and generosity has a price.

focuses.name: The Coast Watch
focuses.desc: The coast is watched by beacon, by boat and by patrol. Selen will see a keel on the horizon before the harbour-master does.

focuses.name: The Frontier Hub
focuses.desc: Selen becomes the meeting-place of the league's frontier companies, with a map-hall in its capital and a court of captains who argue in front of it.

focuses.name: Rumours of an Heir
focuses.desc: Scholars of the First Men have heard that the line of kings did not die out. Letters pass between the university and a few trusted lodges, and the wardens begin to listen.

focuses.name: Alleria Investigates
focuses.desc: Alleria has seen a traveller at the edge of the greenwood who does not move like a common man. She follows him by night and begins to wonder who the Stranger is.

focuses.name: The Rangers' Shelter
focuses.desc: The Stranger is lodged in the hall of a ranger, among the quiet and the observant. No one in the greenwood will say that he is there, and no one has to.

focuses.name: Heed the Warning
focuses.desc: The Stranger speaks of a darkness in the south and a king who cannot hear it. Selen's wardens have listened to stranger things, and have learned to take warning seriously.

focuses.name: Proof in the Old Rolls
focuses.desc: The University's oldest rolls are laid beside the Stranger's own tale. The lines agree, to the letter, and for the first time in years the scholars of Selen forget to be careful.

focuses.name: Keep Him Hidden
focuses.desc: Rangers cover the Stranger's tracks, change his lodging each night and answer all questions with a shrug. Anyone who comes asking will find only trees.

focuses.name: An Oath to the Heir
focuses.desc: On the old stone of Harion the wardens of Selen swear to the Heir. It is an oath of men who have chosen with open eyes, and who know what it may cost them.

focuses.name: Mourning in Selen
focuses.desc: The Golden King is dead, and Selen mourns him as it mourned the kings before. The wardens close the lodges for thirty days and think about what comes after.

focuses.name: For the Free Dominions
focuses.desc: Selen throws its weight behind the dominions who would have their charters back. The Golden Court reads the news in silence, and does not forget it.

focuses.name: For Order in Parim
focuses.desc: Selen declares for order. The Concord has lasted seventeen centuries, and the wardens will not be the ones to break it, whoever sits in Parim.

focuses.name: For the Stranger's Host
focuses.desc: Selen sends word to the Stranger's popular host that the greenwood will stand with it. The wardens have chosen their side, and it is not the one with the palace.

focuses.name: Break the Charter
focuses.desc: Selen declares the Charter void and leaves the Concord, taking its rangers, its university and its grievances. It is a bitter choice, and a long time coming.

focuses.name: Selen Under Arms
focuses.desc: Horns sound in every lodge of the greenwood, and rangers who have not left their glades in years take down their bows. Selen is going to war.

focuses.name: The Men of Selen
focuses.desc: The men of Selen take their place in the Stranger's coalition, with their own banners and their own captains. They came on foot, and they came from every glade.

focuses.name: The Ravine Road
focuses.desc: Rangers comb the cliff paths below the palace, calling the Stranger's name down every gully. They find nothing at first, and they go on looking.

focuses.name: The Old Service Passages
focuses.desc: Alleria remembers the tunnels the palace servants once used, and the rangers know where each one ends. A way into Parim is found that the palace guard has long forgotten.

focuses.name: Free Banners of Selen
focuses.desc: Selen raises banners that belong to no king: the green stag of the wardens on a white field. Wherever they are carried, the greenwood goes with them.

focuses.name: A Treaty, Not a Crown
focuses.desc: After the coronation Selen drops the name of the Host and stays a free realm, bound to the new crown by treaty and not by charter. The wardens go home, and the lodges open their doors again.
